recommendations.title: Margin-First Growth Pivot
recommendations.action: Shift corporate incentive structures from gross sales volume to net profit margin targets to counteract the -76.55% revenue contraction with quality earnings.
recommendations.expected_impact: 12% to 18% increase in Net Profit Margin Percentage within 12 months.

recommendations.title: Dynamic Discounting Guardrails
recommendations.action: Implement a tiered discount approval matrix that caps automated discounts at 5% for any SKU with a historical margin below 10%.
recommendations.expected_impact: 20% to 30% reduction in profit erosion caused by promotional activities.

recommendations.title: Loss-Making Transaction Audit
recommendations.action: Identify and flag all transactions with negative profit (down to -72.50) for immediate manual review and root cause analysis of pricing errors.
recommendations.expected_impact: 5% to 8% immediate lift in Average Profit per Order by eliminating value-destructive sales.

recommendations.title: Portfolio Diversification Program
recommendations.action: Reduce dependency on the Technology category (50% volume) by expanding the Office Supplies and Furniture segments through targeted marketing in the West and North regions.
recommendations.expected_impact: 15% reduction in regional economic risk and improved portfolio-wide margin stability.

recommendations.title: SKU Rationalization and Repricing
recommendations.action: Conduct a profitability audit on high-value SKUs (AOV 641.50) to identify items with near-zero profit correlation and adjust list prices or discontinue low-performers.
recommendations.expected_impact: 10% to 15% improvement in operational efficiency and capital allocation.

recommendations.title: Customer Segment Profitability Review
recommendations.action: Analyze the 'Consumer' vs 'Corporate' segments to identify which group is driving the 11% average discount and adjust loyalty program terms accordingly.
recommendations.expected_impact: Immediate identification of high-cost customer segments to optimize marketing spend.
